_comment: Inventory of the Space Apps that live in THIS repo and ship to the SenClaw
hub (https://senclaw.bacnd.com). The other ~45 apps moved to the
NortonBen/senclaw-app repo, which has its own apps.json + build.yml; only the
two local-model engine apps stayed here because their source is the daemon's
old src/local_model/ and they build against app-space-sdk by path.
Fields (a superset of the senclaw-app schema):
id/dir/port/lang/crate/bin/zip  identity + how to build the crate
platforms   which OS/arch a zip is built for. candle is pure Rust and
ships everywhere; mlx-lm links MLX and is Apple-Silicon only,
stage       [src, dest] pairs copied beside the binary. web/ is a static
dir (index.html) served by ServeDir from exe_dir/web, so it is
staged as-is — there is no npm build.
metallib    true -> stage mlx.metallib beside the binary. MLX resolves its
shader library relative to the executable, so the engine cannot
run without it. It is a build artifact, found under target/.
build:false takes an app out of CI without deleting its row (see ci-plan.sh).
